description: ClinicalExperiments E2 cyclic-phase full-SPARE train (same split/seeds as E1).
cond_formula: [cos 2πθ_ref, sin 2πθ_ref, cos 2πθ_tgt, sin 2πθ_tgt], θ = phase_index / n_phases
patient_split_method: Use all P1..P9 for training; no SPARE hold-out patients.
val_split_method: Per train patient: Random(val_split_seed + patient_index).shuffle(100 pairs); take first 10% as val.
